lines.text: A lot of us think the answer is once a day.
But in a large U.S. health survey, for most people, normal ran from three times a day to three times a week.
What matters more is your normal, and when it changes.
Three times a week can be normal for one person, and a big change for someone else.
But you can't spot a change in a pattern you've never seen.
Get Regular tracks your rhythm from your own logs, so a change stands out.
Know your normal. Then notice what moves.
